subject.title: [Bug]: document-extract plugin loads but registers zero capabilities (bundled, 2026.6.1)

question: Should this issue stay open for package-level PDF extraction proof after the merged inspect fix, and how should the still-open build-format PR be handled?
rationale: Current main fixes the inspect JSON symptom, but maintainer discussion and source inspection do not prove the installed PDF extraction workflow is fixed, and the open PR is reviewed as cleanup rather than a confirmed root-cause fix.

options.title: Keep Open For Runtime Proof
options.body: Leave this issue open until a packaged OpenClaw build proves `document-extract` loads and extracts a real PDF through the user path, while treating DOCX as separate feature scope.

options.title: Close After Diagnostic Fix Ships
options.body: Close once maintainers decide the issue's central problem was only the inspect capability count and accept that runtime/DOCX claims should be reported separately.

options.title: Resolve Through The Open Build PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95059 only if maintainers accept it as cleanup and separately provide package-level proof before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Runtime Proof
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until a packaged OpenClaw build proves `document-extract` loads and extracts a real PDF through the user path, while treating DOCX as separate feature scope.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is about the merged diagnostic fix, the open build-format PR, and issue-state handling; this handle has the clearest recent review and merge context for that boundary.
